description: Shared schema primitives and reusable definitions used across workspace entity schemas.

entity-type-id.$comment: An entity type's canonical name (a single component from the entity type's 'names' property) or the entity type's entity id. Never the entity type's display-name.
entity-type-id.description: An entity type's canonical name (from the entity type's 'names' property, e.g. 'task') or its entity id. Not the display-name, which is a human-facing label and is not interchangeable with the name.

x-entity-types.$comment: Optional array of allowed entity-type ids constraining an entity-id reference. Absent means any entity type is allowed.

entity-name.$comment: An array of strings, used when the name consists of one or more parts that need to be kept separate (e.g. a pull request id in a specific repository).

entity-id-list.$comment: An array of entity-id references. Constrain the allowed entity types of the members by placing x-entity-types as a sibling of the $ref to this def.

anyOf.$comment: A simple string, used when localization is not needed, interpreted as "default".

A localized string, where the keys are locale names (e.g. "en-US", "fr-FR") and the values are the localized strings for those locales. The "default" key is used as a fallback when a specific locale is not available.

hosted-on-computer.$comment: Base type for entities that are hosted on or associated with a computer. Requires either 'computer' or 'computer-user-profile' in the names array.
